name: Aurora
oneLiner: A deep polar sky with slow bands of green and violet light drifting behind calm, low-noise interface chrome.
bestFor: developer platforms with a hero moment
avoidFor: screens that must render on low-end GPUs

effects.noise: 2% grain over the gradient field only, to prevent banding
effects.aura: the gradient field is a fixed layer behind content; content surfaces stay opaque

motion.reducedMotion: freeze the aurora field in place; keep opacity transitions under 200ms

primary.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.5); background: rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.12); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 500; backdrop-filter: blur(8px)

solid.base: height: 44px; padding: 0 22px; border-radius: 999px; border: 0; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); color: var(--uiux-color-accentText); font-size: 0.9375rem; font-weight: 600

default.base: padding: 28px; border-radius: 20px; background: rgba(12, 18, 36, 0.72); border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); backdrop-filter: blur(24px); box-shadow: 0 24px 60px -24px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6)
default.top-edge: background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.6), transparent); height: 1px; position: absolute; inset: 0 20% auto 20%

default.base: height: 48px; width: 100%; padding: 0 16px; border-radius: 12px; border: 1px solid var(--uiux-color-border); background: rgba(6, 10, 22, 0.6); color: var(--uiux-color-text); font-size: 1rem

display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 26px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.35); background: rgba(94, 234, 212, 0.08); font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.04em; color: var(--uiux-color-accent)
default.dot: width: 5px; height: 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--uiux-color-accent); box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--uiux-color-accent)

default.base: font-size: 2.5rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.04em; line-height: 1; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #EAF0FF 0%, #9FB0D0 100%); -webkit-background-clip: text; background-clip: text; color: transparent
default.label: margin-top: 8px; font-size: 0.8125rem; color: var(--uiux-color-textMuted)

do: Keep the aurora in one fixed background layer with three soft radial gradients and a 2% grain to stop banding.
Let content surfaces be opaque or lightly translucent; text must sit on a stable backdrop.
Use one mint accent for interaction; violet and blue stay atmospheric.
Animate the field extremely slowly (60s+) or not at all.
dont: Do not put body copy directly over the brightest part of the gradient.
Do not animate the background faster than 40 seconds per cycle.
Do not add a second gradient field inside cards.
Do not use aurora colors as status colors; green here reads as ambience, not success.
antiPatterns: Full-bleed animated mesh gradient behind a 14px grey paragraph — unreadable and nauseating.
Every card washed in a different hue so the page reads as a rainbow instead of a sky.
Neon aurora gradients behind a white light-mode form with no contrast adjustment.

notes: Background gradient luminance varies; put text on the opaque surface token, never directly on the field.
Slow ambient motion still needs prefer-reduced-motion support — freeze, do not remove.
The accent must stay at 3:1 against the darkest and lightest parts of the field for focus rings to remain visible.
